headline: Ocean-freight stress is HIGH and rising — 40.8/100; Taiwan Strait is the lead driver, +56% vs normal

bullets.text: Global Ocean Freight Stress is **40.8/100** (**high**), up 13.0 pts week-over-week. 5 of 28 monitored chokepoints are disrupted.
The biggest driver is **Taiwan Strait**, running **401.0/day** vs a normal of **257.6/day** (+56%).
**347** changes to the disruption set since the last update.
Also moving now: **Strait of Hormuz** is running **83% below** normal.
Market context: Brent crude **$81.62/bbl** (+9.79% prev_close) — context for the energy-route chokepoints, not a stated cause.
Against the loaded sample trade book, **$486.5M** routes through disrupted lanes — an estimated **$1.0M** cost-of-delay ($500K–$1.7M).
